subject.title: Next Sprint B: model-input validation guardrails

question: Should configured model `input` values beyond text/image be invalid, valid metadata only, or valid only through an explicit override/capability contract?
rationale: Current main intentionally accepts and preserves audio/video in some config/catalog surfaces while other runtime and docs paths still treat text/image as the supported chat-model input contract.

options.title: Define Contract First
options.body: Choose the canonical meaning of audio/video model inputs before implementation, then make one aligned schema/runtime/docs/test change with migration handling if needed.

options.title: Strictly Reject Unsupported Inputs
options.body: Treat audio/video as invalid for configured chat-model inputs and add tests, docs, and doctor migration for existing configs that now violate the contract.

options.title: Accept Metadata With Guardrails
options.body: Keep audio/video as valid metadata but add runtime-specific selection checks, clearer diagnostics, and docs separating chat input support from media-understanding or future metadata.

recommendation.title: Define Contract First
recommendation.body: Choose the canonical meaning of audio/video model inputs before implementation, then make one aligned schema/runtime/docs/test change with migration handling if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans provider/config public API, catalog normalization, and media-selection behavior where steipete has the strongest recent adjacent history.
